description: Source code for a memory technology device (MTD) manipulation tool, including functions for opening, checking, erasing, writing, verifying, and dumping MTD devices, as well as command-line interface handling.

methods.name: mtd_open
methods.description: Opens an MTD device, trying to resolve device number from /proc/mtd if possible.

methods.name: mtd_check_open
methods.description: Checks and opens an MTD device, retrieves device info such as size and type.

methods.name: mtd_block_is_bad
methods.description: Checks if a block at a given offset is bad (for NAND flash).

methods.name: mtd_erase_block
methods.description: Erases a block at a given offset.

methods.name: mtd_write_buffer
methods.description: Writes a buffer to an MTD device at a specified offset.

methods.name: image_check
methods.description: Checks the magic number of an image file to determine its format.

methods.name: mtd_check
methods.description: Checks and opens an MTD device, handling multiple device parts separated by colons.

methods.name: mtd_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks one or multiple MTD devices.

methods.name: mtd_erase
methods.description: Erases an entire MTD device, skipping bad blocks.

methods.name: mtd_dump
methods.description: Outputs the contents of an MTD device to stdout.

methods.name: mtd_verify
methods.description: Verifies the content of an MTD device against a file by comparing MD5 hashes.

methods.name: indicate_writing
methods.description: Displays a message indicating data is being written to an MTD device.

methods.name: mtd_write
methods.description: Writes an image to an MTD device, handling partitioning, bad blocks, and optional FIS layout.

methods.name: mtd_write_jffs2
methods.description: Appends a file to a JFFS2 partition on an MTD device.

methods.name: mtd_fixtrx
methods.description: Fixes the checksum in a TRX header on first boot.

methods.name: mtd_fixseama
methods.description: Fixes the checksum in a SEAMA header on first boot.

methods.name: mtd_fixwrg
methods.description: Fixes the checksum in a WRG header on first boot.

methods.name: mtd_fixwrgg
methods.description: Fixes the checksum in a WRGG header on first boot.
